prompt: A worker service needs to publish a batch of N messages to a RabbitMQ broker that's one network hop away, using publisher confirms so every message is durably acknowledged by the broker before we consider the batch done. Here's the `publishBatch` function currently running in production — it opens a confirm channel and works correctly, but throughput collapses under load even though it looked perfectly fine in testing, where we only ever sent a single message at a time. Walk me through why it's slow, then optimize it so publishing a full batch doesn't cost more network round-trips than it has to.
